items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: That little kid he called Joe on drums.

ctx.x: We put up a long time in the show there. Was it a good band? Yeah, we had a good band in there. That little kid he called Joe on drums. And, uh, let me see who it was. Had Joe, they had Howard. Had Howard.
Drew Howard, Paul. Myself. What was Paul playing?
